description: geoserver.vuvh.sk: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.vuvh.sk. Coverage: the area served by geoserver.vuvh.sk. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Vypúšťanie odpadových vôd - Obce s verejnou kanalizáciou; Vypúšťanie odpadových vôd - Čistiarne odpadových vôd nad 2000 EO; Zariadenia environmentálneho manažmentu - Čistiarne komunálnych odpado; PD 32,01 Komunálne čistiarne odpadových vôd. Ukladacia služba. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk), as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
